# Vendored Plotly

`plotly-4.3.0.min.js` is Plotly.js 4.3.0 from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/plotly.js-dist-min@4.3.0/plotly.min.js`.

To upgrade, replace the file, update the `<script>` tag in `index.html`, and read the Plotly changelog for breaking changes.
Keep `showSendToCloud: false` in the plot config: since 4.0 Plotly shows an upload-to-cloud button by default.
